about: Measured with transformers by fc-probe (#107): Qwen3.5-2B (teacher, '2B') and the untrained Qwen3.5-0.8B (student, '0.8B'), bf16, thinking off, teacher-forced, at the revisions the eval runs used (2B 15852e8, 0.8B 2fc0636). A made-up query and the 2B's greedy answer. Per answer position and model: the logits (minus the max) of the union of both models' top-8 tokens, and a 120-bin histogram [mean logit, count] of every other token.
query: Give me the forecast for Lisbon.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get the weather forecast for a city.
